items.a: Yes. There is no paid plan and no trial. They are free because they show the kind of work I do for clients: if you need the fixes done, you know where to find me.

items.q: What data do the extensions collect?
items.a: None. Each extension saves only its own settings on your computer. The pages you check are read in your browser and nothing is sent to a server.
No. Nothing runs in the background. A tool only works on a tab after you click its icon or press its shortcut there.

items.q: Which one should I install first?
items.a: Pick your role in the tool list above. If you run paid campaigns, start with Hitline: broken tracking costs the most and is the hardest to see.

items.q: Can I use them for client work?
items.a: Yes. Agencies use the PDF reports in audits and pitches. The reports carry a small "Made with" line and nothing else.
English and Azerbaijani. You can switch the language in each tool's settings.

about.title: Need the fixes done, not just found?
about.text: I am Shamistan Isayev. I work on analytics, server-side tracking and CRO, and I built these tools for the checks I run on every project. When you want someone to fix what they find, book a call.
